title: ScalarCohomologyExtZeroGlobalSections
statement: For a field k, a scheme X over Spec k, a module sheaf F, and a degree-zero scalar cohomology class a, the scalar Ext comparison of a is the degree-zero Ext class represented by the morphism from the structure sheaf associated to the global section corresponding to a, followed by scalar restriction.

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution. The defining cocycle formula for moduleExtEquiv identifies the cocycle obtained from the canonical degree-zero comparison with the augmentation composed with homOfGlobalSection. The degree-zero augmentation lemma identifies this Ext class with mk₀ of homOfGlobalSection. Unfold scalarCohomologyExtEquiv and scalarExtMap; exact-functor transport sends mk₀ to mk₀ and composition with scalarUnitMorphism gives the claimed scalar Ext class.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCohomologyExtEquiv_zero_globalSections
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F : X.Modules)
    (a : scalarCohomology f F 0) :
    scalarCohomologyExtEquiv f F 0 a =
      Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (scalarUnitMorphism f ≫
        scalarHom f (homOfGlobalSection F (scalarGlobalSectionsEquiv f F a)))
